# Holdem

> Holdem is the Dropover for Windows: an open-source (MIT) floating file shelf. Free from GitHub, or $4.99 on the Microsoft Store (7-day free trial, same app). Shake your mouse while dragging to summon a holding area for files, folders, images, links and text — navigate anywhere, then drop them where needed. Windows 10 (1809+)/11 x64. Built with Tauri + Rust.

## Docs

- [Pricing](https://holdem.iamzub.in/pricing): free from GitHub (MIT, nothing locked, no wait timers), or $4.99 one-time on the Microsoft Store with a 7-day free trial. Same features either way.
- [Changelog](https://holdem.iamzub.in/changelog): v3.2.0 multiple shelves, persistent shelf, preview, item actions, image resize/convert, paste; v3.1.1 file-drop reliability; v3.1.0 native OLE drops, 25-locale i18n; v3.0.0 first Windows release.

  - [vs DropPoint](https://holdem.iamzub.in/vs/droppoint)

## How it works

1. Install and launch — Holdem sits in the system tray (enable auto-launch).
2. Start dragging files in Explorer, then shake the mouse — the shelf appears at your cursor. Or press the global hotkey (Win+Shift+H, customizable), or turn on opening it by holding a drag against a screen edge.
3. Drop files, folders, or browser images onto the shelf; let go of the mouse.
4. Switch folders, apps, or desktops freely; drag items out to finish. Shelf auto-hides when empty.
5. Right-click the tray icon for settings, hotkey, and quick actions.

## Features

- Floating always-on-top shelf (draggable, 165x175, skip-taskbar)
- Shake-to-summon while dragging + global hotkey
- Native Windows OLE drops: Explorer files/folders, web images, links, text snippets, email attachments, classic Outlook emails (.msg), chat images, files from ZIP/7-Zip/WinRAR; paste with Ctrl+V
- Multiple shelves as tabs (Ctrl+Tab); reopen a closed shelf with Ctrl+Shift+T for 7 days; shelf survives restarts
- Item actions: Space to preview, Ctrl+C copy as files, copy paths, copy to folder, ZIP, pin, undo, F2 rename; image resize and PNG/JPEG convert
- Light/dark/system theme, Mica on Windows 11; clear messages when a drop fails
- System-tray integration with settings and quick actions
- Auto-launch on login + auto-update (GitHub build: https://holdem.iamzub.in/update.json; Store build updates through the Microsoft Store)
- 25 languages, browser-locale detection, RTL layout
- Low memory use (Tauri/Rust backend)

## Roadmap

- Custom opacity controls

## FAQ

- Is Holdem really free? Yes — the GitHub build is MIT open-source with no paywall or wait timers. The Microsoft Store version ($4.99, 7-day trial) is the same app; buying it supports development.
- Windows versions? Windows 10 version 1809 or later and Windows 11 (x64).
- Dropover/Dropshelf/Yoink alternative? Yes — those are Mac-only or freemium; Holdem brings the shelf workflow to Windows, free or $4.99 on the Store.
- How do I summon it? Shake while dragging, or the global hotkey.
- Source code? https://github.com/iamzubin/holdem — bug reports and PRs welcome; translations via Crowdin.
